subject: Hosted API pricing: per-1M token rates & model availability
messages:
From: Alice Nguyen <alice@acmehealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick question on pricing and model list for hosted API

Hi Ben,

We’re evaluating Redwood for a POC and I need the quick baseline numbers to model cost. Can you send your standard per-1M token pricing for input vs output (if you break them out), and the list of hosted models you offer today with obvious cost/latency differences called out?

Also: do you have a published rate card PDF or a short matrix that includes embedding pricing? Our legal/finance team will want a one-pager.

Thanks,
Alice Nguyen
AI Product Lead, Acme Health
alice@acmehealth.com

P.S. Rough expected volume: ~10M input tokens / month and ~30M output tokens during POC.
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-29T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick question on pricing and model list for hosted API

Hi Alice,

Thanks for reaching out — happy to help. Attaching our current hosted rate card (PDF) which shows list prices and a short model catalog. High-level baseline (public hosted rates):
- Generation (per 1M tokens): $1,200 per 1M input tokens (prompt) / $2,400 per 1M output tokens (completion) for our latest high-capacity models (approx. equivalent to 70B-class).
- Mid-tier models (cost-optimized): $800 input / $1,600 output per 1M tokens.
- Small low-cost models: $250 input / $500 output per 1M tokens.
- Embeddings (per 1M vectors): $650 per 1M embeddings (single-vector rows).

Notes:
- Prices above are list (hosted) and exclude committed discounts and volume tiers.
- We typically bill tokens separately for input vs output; you can also request a blended per-request rate for predictable billing.
- The attached PDF includes a model catalog summary with latency/throughput guidance per model class.

I’ve CC’d Marissa (our commercial lead) who can outline commitment tiers and potential POC pricing or short-term credits. If you like, we can do a 30-minute call later this week to map your usage profile to savings scenarios.

Attachments: redwood-hosted-ratecard-march2026.pdf

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0193
From: Alice Nguyen <alice@acmehealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-30T08:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick question on pricing and model list for hosted API

Thanks Ben — that helps. A few quick clarifying questions from our side before we sync:

1) For embeddings, are the per-1M units billed per vector generated or per call? We’ll likely embed batches of up to 512 records.
2) Do you expose quantized model variants on hosted so we could pick a lower-cost option without running Dedicated?
3) For the numbers you quoted, is output token pricing including any streaming surcharge or is streaming the same rate?
4) Any POC credits or short-term discounts for early pilots?

I attached a rough usage spreadsheet so your team can model the expected token split.

Thanks — Alice

Attachment: acme_mlp_usage_estimate.xlsx
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-30T10:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick question on pricing and model list for hosted API

Hi Alice — quick answers inline: 

1) Embeddings: billed per vector generated (so a batch of 512 records = 512 vectors). We show per-1M vectors on the rate card.
2) Hosted currently exposes cost-optimized model variants (smaller and quantized-friendly builds) in the catalog; you can select those via the API model parameter without moving to Dedicated. Latency/throughput will be called out in the catalog.
3) Streaming is billed at the same per-token rate; no separate streaming surcharge for hosted API.
4) Yes — we commonly offer a small POC credit (one-off) and an introductory committed discount for the first 3–6 months depending on commitment size. I’ve looped in Marissa to propose an initial POC discount for Acme Health.

If it helps, we can run your attached estimate through a quick cost model and return a 3-month and 12-month projection with and without a 6-month commit. Interested in a call tomorrow at 11am PT?

Best,
Ben
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice@acmehealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-31T15:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick question on pricing and model list for hosted API

Hi Alice — nice to meet you (virtually).

For Acme Health we can offer the following POC commercial options:
- No-commit POC: $5k platform credit valid for 60 days (covers a small-scale POC).
- Short commit: 3-month, $10k commit -> 10% off list hosted rates across generation and embeddings.
- Introductory 6-month: $50k commit -> 20% off list rates + expedited onboarding + one dedicated onboarding hours with Solutions Engineering.

If you’re mainly evaluating for cost modeling, I’ll run the attached estimate through our cost tool and share a side-by-side that shows list vs 10% vs 20% scenarios plus recommended model choices (latency vs cost tradeoffs).

Next steps:
1) I’ll send the cost projection and a short one-pager with the model catalog highlights by end of day tomorrow.
2) If that looks good, we can schedule a 30–45 minute technical deep dive with SE to validate latency targets and throughput.

Do you want the 11am PT Ben suggested tomorrow or would you prefer Friday morning?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Commercial Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0228
